text:
You need a WordPress landing page that looks polished, matches your design mockup, captures leads effectively, works smoothly on mobile, and includes email marketing integration, tracking pixels, and A/B testing.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience building modern web interfaces and performance-focused pages. My background includes JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API work, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS, so I’m comfortable turning a design into a clean, responsive implementation with careful attention to detail. While my core stack is modern JavaScript, I’m used to working in content-driven environments and building frontend experiences that are easy to manage, fast, and conversion-focused.

A relevant project was the Home goods storefront rebuild for Juniper & Ash Home. I replaced a slow theme-based shop with a headless storefront and CMS the marketing team edits themselves. The result was a largest contentful paint improvement from 4.1s to 1.3s, and organic traffic increased by 38% in 3 months. That project sharpened my focus on performance, responsive layout quality, and building pages that support business goals rather than just looking good.

For your landing page, I would focus on:
- Translating your mockup accurately into a responsive page
- Keeping the layout clean and optimized for lead generation
- Integrating your email marketing platform correctly
- Setting up tracking pixels carefully
- Implementing A/B testing in a way that is reliable and easy to measure
- Applying SEO best practices where appropriate

I’m detail-oriented, comfortable working within defined timelines, and I understand that a landing page needs to be both visually strong and technically sound. If you’d like, I can help you turn the mockup into a page that is ready to launch and measure.
